question: Which special FM radio channels were launched by UP Chief Minister Yogi Adityanath for the Maha Kumbh 2025 in Prayagraj?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Kumbhvani and Kumbh Mangal Dhwani**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

 
• CM Yogi Adityanath inaugurated **Kumbhvani** (103.5 MHz) and **Kumbh Mangal Dhwani** on January 10, 2025, in Prayagraj. Union Minister Dr. L. Murugan joined online.
